prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: revised game environment concept board explaining an ENTERABLE small campus kiosk, preview only.
Input image 1: current runtime location and exact game camera/style. Its red outline shows a roof/solid footprint problem; UI and red outline are annotations to remove.
Input image 2: approved kiosk architecture, colors, storefront and stock detail to retain.
Primary request: Redesign the existing kiosk to have a clearly legible WEST SIDE ENTRY facing the paved lane toward the canteen, while retaining its SOUTH outdoor sales counter. The previous shop is an inaccessible solid prefab. This revised concept must visibly demonstrate a genuine side doorway and walkable interior like other game rooms. Show exactly the same building in roof-on exterior and roof-off entered states.
Composition: polished landscape concept board with TWO equally large main panels side by side, headings "室外 · 侧门入口" and "进入后 · 屋顶隐藏". Modest ivory title strip "小卖铺 · 可进入版本". A small inset or bottom strip shows the WEST doorway closer, labeled "侧门细节". Dominant panels must each be large enough to read the door, shelf arrangement, character and aisle. Use the game's nearly top-down orthographic 2.5D view, all map axes horizontal/vertical, subtle visible front/side faces, NO diagonally rotated isometric view. This is an in-game concept, not a realistic architectural render.
Exterior panel: same compact rectangular kiosk, muted sage corrugated roof with vent, ivory plaster sides and green trim, honey-brown wooden south sales counter, small centered ivory "小卖铺" sign and narrow metal canopy. Preserve the storefront character and location between workshop north, canteen west and garden east. Roof surface spans the actual back/side wall envelope; roof edge aligns coherently to the building boundary, never floating over a strip of walkable road. The west wall has a real recessed open SIDE doorway roughly mid-depth, facing LEFT toward the west paved lane. Make it unmistakably traversable WITHOUT relying solely on text: visible dark green door leaf swung open outward west, full-height ivory frame with green metal trim, light interior floor continuing horizontally over a shallow threshold to the outside lane, a clear unblocked rectangular door aperture, tiny practical warm wall lamp and plain small "入口" plate. Roof edge above this doorway ends in a purposeful cutback/door hood to expose the aperture and threshold from the nearly overhead camera; never obscure doorway beneath a solid roof slab. No stairs/high curb at threshold. One small orange-clothed inmate approaches from west, and blue-gray shopkeeper remains visible at south counter.
Interior panel: EXACT same footprint and doorway, roof membrane hidden entirely after entering; back/side perimeter walls, south canopy/storefront remain in place. Orange player now INSIDE just east of west doorway. Clear aisle from west door into back store, and toward the cashier service aisle. Back shelves moved to rear/right walls so their footprint never blocks entrance. Legible orderly bottles, biscuit boxes, towels, small supplies and reserve cartons. Plenty of navigable floor at human scale, approximately 100 game units wide clear walking path, compact not cavernous. One blue-gray-clad clerk behind front counter, not merged with building art. Green-gray interior floor, restrained warm stock/wood detail. Counter front still blocks walking from south; access is through the west door only. No second north entrance and no entrance cut into south counter.
Door close-up: faithful same west entry, see open leaf, empty aperture, floor threshold bridging outside to inside. A short discreet dotted route from west lane through doorway to interior may be placed ONLY on inset or interior panel to clarify entry, no bright graffiti-like arrows on architecture.
A single minimal footer sentence, exact Chinese: "外墙阻挡 · 侧门通行 · 室内保留走道". Visually communicate the perimeter/door collision rule and coherent roof boundary; DO NOT draw the entire interior as one solid collision rectangle. No debug overlays/red collision outlines.
Style/materials: match supplied game's fine painted sprites, restrained earthy greens and warm wood, crisp small game-readable forms, subtle short shadows, neutral daylight. Keep existing outdoor green-gray square pavement and garden, no new road-floor style, no additional building annex stealing the lane. Avoid neon, real brands, large supermarket, warehouse aesthetic, excessive dirt, high contrast glow, photography, big editorial paragraphs, game HUD, editor UI and watermarks. This revision is about entry/roof readability, retain the previous kiosk visual identity.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: this kiosk side-entry concept board.
Make ONE focused correction ONLY TO THE TOP-RIGHT "进入后 · 屋顶隐藏" panel: it currently mistakenly has TWO cashiers and TWO counters/front signs, one inside and a duplicate external sales facade. Correct to ONE coherent kiosk with ONLY ONE south-facing wooden sales counter, ONLY ONE blue-gray shopkeeper and ONLY ONE "小卖铺" storefront sign, in the same south frontage position as the left exterior panel. Remove the extra inner cashier, extra inner cash register/counter, and duplicate interior/front bar with sign; replace that area with clear continuous interior gray-green tiled walking aisle. Keep stocked shelves along the north/right walls, keep the orange-clothed player inside west side doorway. Maintain the exterior south sales frontage and its original clerk, register and stock cabinets once. Retain a narrow fixed green rain canopy and one sign above this single south sales frontage, and have only the main rectangular back-store roof hidden. The interior walking aisle from the west entry runs into the storage space and to behind the sole sales counter. Show one exact matching building geometry/footprint, not a double shop. If necessary shift interior shelves slightly north to maintain doorway clearance, but do not expand footprint.
Keep EVERY OTHER PART unchanged: left roof-on panel, west door location, open green door, small lamp and "入口" plate, bottom-left doorway close-up, board layout, text, nearby roads, canteen, garden, palette, camera, style. Do not duplicate the shopkeeper anywhere within a single panel. No HUD or debug marks.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a clean final revised game concept board "小卖铺 · 侧门可进入方案" using image 1's approved kiosk visual identity, with a real WEST entrance. Image1 is a style/layout reference only. Do NOT copy its board arrangement.
IMPORTANT: Each building view contains exactly ONE cashier, ONE cash register, ONE wooden south SALES COUNTER and ONE shop sign. Never draw a second interior counter above an exterior counter. The counter is the single south wall of the whole building. The cashier stands INSIDE the same room, immediately north/behind that one counter, facing south. A tiny south canopy with sign above this counter may remain, but never draw a second facade below it.
Board layout: LARGE MAIN LEFT VIEW (about two thirds of board) shows roof-off enterable interior, cropped map environment around it. Right column has small roof-on outside view on top, and western door closeup on bottom. Two states of same single compact rectangular building. Pale ivory margin, readable restrained Chinese headings "室内 · 进入后屋顶隐藏", "室外 · 屋顶覆盖", "西侧门口".
Main left: near-overhead orthographic 2.5D game camera; map edges vertical/horizontal, no diagonal isometric axes. Rectangular kiosk in same campus between workshop north, canteen west, garden east. Back main roof is hidden, showing shallow ivory rear/side walls with muted green metal trim. NORTH back wall has a wall shelf stocked with bottles, biscuits, packets and towels. EAST wall has narrow supply shelves and a small green locker. WEST wall about mid-depth has a clearly open SIDE door facing west toward canteen paved lane, green metal door leaf swung outward left, cream frame, flush gray-green threshold floor continuing from outside lane to inside. Do NOT place any shelf or cabinet over this doorway. Orange-clothed inmate now stands INSIDE near side door. A broad unobstructed central gray-green floor aisle connects west doorway to stocked back area and behind the cashier's south counter. One blue-gray work-shirt clerk stands at south edge, behind ONE warm honey-brown sales counter with register at left, price paper and packet goods at right. On each counter end a slim stock display cabinet; side cabinets don't block west door. Keep single south storefront canopy with an ivory "小卖铺" sign visually tied to the counter. Never add another sign or counter inside. NO counter across the central aisle. Store is compact, shelves are perimeter mounted, aisle spacious enough for two game people to pass, no unnecessary annex.
Right top exterior: exact same geometry, back room covered by complete muted sage green corrugated roof with square vent, slim edging, low south rain canopy above sole counter, shopkeeper visible through sale aperture. WEST door remains clearly exposed in a purposefully recessed wall niche with a small side roof hood, short warm wall lamp, tiny ivory "入口" plate, empty door aperture and visible ground threshold. Roof does not hide the west doorway. One orange game character outside west entry at appropriate scale. Roof edge and solid exterior walls share a coherent boundary; no character walking over the roof top strip. Main roof fits over room walls, no overscaled slab over adjacent road.
Right bottom doorway detail: open green leaf, ivory frame, empty passage, continuous flush floor paving, lamp and "入口" plate. Shows a genuine room doorway rather than a painted door attached to an unbroken wall.
One concise footer exact: "外墙阻挡 · 侧门放行 · 室内保留通道".
Rendering: faithful finely painted game sprites, matte ivory/green architecture, warm wood, restrained wear, subtle outline and shadows, existing green-gray square outdoor pavement unchanged, partial garden/canteen for setting, neutral daytime.
Avoid: full HUD/editor UI, red markings, duplicated cashiers, duplicated counters, duplicate signs, stacked two shopfronts, arbitrary third doorway, modern neon, brands, new road material, full panoramic tiny shop, photo realism, diagonal isometric projection, explanatory paragraphs.

design_notes: West side entry faces canteen lane; open green leaf, ivory door frame, lamp, flush continuous threshold.
Roof and solid exterior boundary must align; no walkable strip inside visible north roof edge.
Split collisions into perimeter walls, shelf/counter footprints and open doorway; preserve walkable interior.
Roof hides after valid side-door entry; exterior south sales counter remains usable.
Future production should separate walls, door, shelving and counter sprites; the existing one-piece solid building should be replaced.
